title: Enterprise Multi-Agent LLM RAG & Vector Memory Mesh
subtitle: Distributed semantic search, hybrid sparse-dense retrieval, agentic tool orchestration, and LLM guardrails at enterprise scale.

overview.summary: A resilient multi-agent RAG system powering autonomous domain copilot swarms with sub-second semantic retrieval, token caching, hallucination guardrails, and secure sandboxed tool execution.
overview.problemStatement: Direct LLM queries lack fresh organizational knowledge, exhibit unpredictable hallucinations, risk prompt injection attacks, and incur exorbitant token inference costs.
corePrinciples: Hybrid dense-sparse retrieval combining vector embeddings and BM25 full-text rankers
Hierarchical agent orchestration with dynamic step budgeting and loop breakers
Semantic caching layer reducing up to 68% of redundant LLM token costs
Zero-data-leakage guardrail gateway with streaming token validation

data.label: Enterprise Copilot UI
data.subtitle: SSE & WebSocket Streaming
data.description: Interactive AI interface supporting real-time token streaming, cited source popovers, and multimodal attachments.

specs.failoverStrategy: Client reconnect retry with state re-hydration

data.label: Guardrails & Safety Gateway
data.subtitle: Prompt Defense & PII Redaction
data.description: High-throughput security proxy inspecting user prompts for injection attacks, jailbreaks, PII scrubbing, and quota limits.
responsibilities: Sanitizes prompts and scrubs sensitive PII tokens

data.label: Agent Swarm Orchestrator
data.subtitle: LangGraph & Task Planner
data.description: Stateful workflow engine coordinating planner agents, tool selector bots, and iterative reasoning loops with execution limits.

specs.failoverStrategy: Stateful checkpointing via Temporal workflow graphs

responsibilities: Decomposes complex requests into directed acyclic graphs (DAG)
Routes subtasks to specialized specialist agents
Controls max iteration count to prevent runaway reasoning loops

data.label: Semantic Prompt Cache
data.subtitle: Redis Vector Cosine Cache
data.description: Embedding-based similarity cache intercepting duplicate and semantically similar queries before dispatching to LLM providers.
responsibilities: Stores query embeddings and verified response pairs
Returns cached responses on > 0.96 cosine similarity
Saves substantial LLM API costs and token quotas

data.label: Vector Embedding Pipeline
data.subtitle: GPU-accelerated BGE / OpenAI
data.description: High-throughput embedding worker converting incoming chunks and queries into normalized 1536-dimensional vectors.

specs.failoverStrategy: Dynamic batching with CPU fallback cluster

data.label: Qdrant Vector Engine
data.subtitle: Hybrid Vector & BM25 Store
data.description: Distributed vector database combining HNSW graphs with payload filtering, multitenant namespaces, and sparse-dense reciprocal rank fusion.
responsibilities: Enforces tenant document access control lists at index level
Executes hybrid fusion ranking for top-k relevant context chunks

data.label: LLM Inference Mesh
data.subtitle: vLLM Multi-Model Gateway
data.description: Multi-provider model gateway routing queries across self-hosted vLLM clusters (Llama-3, DeepSeek) and proprietary LLM endpoints with automatic fallback.

data.label: MicroVM Code Sandbox
data.subtitle: Firecracker Isolated Execution
data.description: Ephemeral microVM sandbox allowing agents to safely run Python scripts, SQL queries, and API integrations with zero network escape risk.

specs.failoverStrategy: Hardware-enforced memory isolation and hard timeout

data.description: Real-time user conversation stream with bearer authorization.
Fast lookup for identical or semantically identical previous answers.
Converts user questions into high-dimensional vector representations.
Finds most relevant knowledge chunks with tenant ACL filters.
Streams generated response tokens back through orchestrator.
Isolated microVM executes calculations and data queries.

tradeoffs.decision: MicroVM Tool Execution vs Direct LLM Arithmetic
tradeoffs.chosenApproach: Ephemeral Firecracker Sandboxes for Deterministic Math
pros: Allows dynamic data processing on massive CSVs/dataframes
Zero host security risk with microVM kernel isolation
cons: Adds ~45ms execution overhead per tool invocation
rejectedAlternatives: Allowing raw Python eval() in Python worker process
Relying purely on LLM reasoning for financial math

tradeoffs.decision: Hybrid Vector Search vs Pure Dense Vector Matching
tradeoffs.chosenApproach: Qdrant HNSW Dense + Sparse BM25 Fusion
pros: Finds exact keyword matches (e.g. error codes, product SKUs, exact part IDs)
Captures conceptual semantics and synonym paraphrasing
Improves retrieval recall by 34% over dense-only
cons: Higher memory usage for dual inverted indices

securityAndCompliance.implementation: Multi-layer guardrail inspection with semantic vector distance to known attack signatures.
Payload-level metadata filtering at vector database index layer, preventing cross-tenant retrieval leakage.
